description: Lists x402-priced endpoints with the price per call the hub read from their own 402 answers, and how that price moved over time. Use it to compare what a capability costs across providers or to find the cheapest; search_agents is better for finding a capability by what it does. Read-only, no account. Returns JSON `endpoints[]` with resource URL, price, asset, network and price history.

maxUsd.description: Only endpoints at or under this price per call, in USD.

origin.description: Only endpoints on this origin, e.g. "https://api.example.com".

name: list_paid_endpoints
title: List paid endpoints
